quiz.title: GAMES WEEK
quiz.greeting: Insert coin! This week's questions have a gaming twist. Press red to begin.
quiz.share: I scored {score}/12 on Flummox!, the Teletext quiz on STEEVEFAX page 152. Can you flummox Felix?

verdicts.text: Felix is utterly FLUMMOXED! A perfect game.
Not bad. Felix has seen worse.
Felix is not flummoxed in the slightest.

questions.question: Which Pac-Man ghost is red?
questions.quip: Right! And he's the one chasing you.

questions.question: Which company made the Game Boy?
questions.quip: Correct! 1989, with Tetris in the box.

questions.question: In which country was Tetris first made, in 1984?
questions.quip: Right! By Alexey Pajitnov, in Moscow.

questions.question: What is Sonic the Hedgehog's two-tailed sidekick called?
Grand Theft Auto was born in which Scottish city?
Digitiser, the video games pages, was on which channel's Teletext?
Who first appeared as Jumpman in 1981's Donkey Kong?
questions.quip: Right! He was a carpenter back then.

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
In which 1983 film does a computer called WOPR play war games?
questions.quip: Correct! The only winning move is not to play.

questions.question: Which home computer was made for a BBC series about computing?
questions.quip: Yes! Built by Acorn, in Cambridge.

questions.question: In chess, which piece only ever moves diagonally?
